note: Some conflicts affect several regions. The sum across all regions can therefore be higher than the global number.
title: Rate of armed conflicts
subtitle: The number of conflicts divided by the number of  all states. This accounts for the changing number of states over time. Included are [interstate](#dod:interstate-conflict), [intrastate](#dod:intrastate-conflict), [extrasystemic](#dod:extrasystemic-ucdp), [non-state](#dod:nonstate-conflict) conflicts, and [one-sided violence](#dod:onesided-violence) that were ongoing that year.
